overview: I’m building my homelab from step zero: a hands-on environment for networking practice, testing, and future server and service hosting. This is a tour of the equipment and how the lab is taking shape; setup guides and lessons learned will live on the blog.

equipment.description: The starting point of the network: the fiber connection from my ISP.

The router I’ll use for hands-on networking practice and testing.

topology.alt: Internet connects to the ISP ONT, then the Nighthawk RAX45 home router. The home network branches to IoT and computers. The homelab extends to the Cisco C1111-4P router and Cisco 3560CX-8PC-S switch. The switch uplink is planned, not confirmed.
